name: doc-to-calendar
description: Universal calendar extractor. Ingests documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, ICS), images/screenshots, or pasted text; supports a zero-prompt `quick` mode; generates RFC 5545 .ics files; and syncs directly to existing or new Google Calendars with per-category colors.
suggestedPrompts: /doc-to-calendar Extract events from this document or screenshot
/doc-to-calendar quick Turn these pasted notes into a calendar
/doc-to-calendar Add this syllabus to Google Calendar with custom colors per category
